key.name: model
key.description: The Ollama model identifier for LLM inference. Empty means auto-select based on hardware capabilities; set explicitly to override.

key.name: hardware-profile
key.description: Selects the model, whisper, and context-window tier based on hardware. Supported values: "auto" (detect at startup), "low", "medium", "high", "gpu". Applied during component initialization at startup; an unknown or blank value behaves like "auto".

key.name: privacy-mode
key.description: When true, all processing happens locally. No data is sent to external servers.

key.name: whisper-model
key.description: The whisper.cpp model to use for transcription. Empty means auto-select based on hardware capabilities; set explicitly (e.g. "tiny", "base", "medium") to override.

key.name: piper-voice
key.description: The voice model for text-to-speech synthesis.

key.name: ollama-host
key.description: The URL of the Ollama inference server.

key.name: auto-start
key.description: Whether to automatically start shani-chronoa on user login.

key.name: notification-enabled
key.summary: Enable spoken replies and timer notifications
key.description: When true, Chronoa speaks its replies aloud (text-to-speech) and timer completions fire a desktop notification. When false, replies are shown on screen only and timers stay silent.

key.name: language
key.description: The language code for speech recognition and interface text.

key.name: debug-mode
key.description: When true, verbose debug output is logged for troubleshooting.

key.name: wake-word-enabled
key.description: When true and openWakeWord is installed, listens continuously for the wake word instead of requiring a button press.

key.name: wake-word-model
key.description: The openWakeWord pretrained model name to activate on. No dedicated "hey chronoa" model has been trained yet, so this defaults to one of openWakeWord's bundled phrases.

key.name: cloud-fallback-enabled
key.summary: Allow falling back to a free cloud LLM when Ollama is unavailable
key.description: When true AND privacy mode is off, Chronoa may send prompts to a free, no-API-key cloud LLM gateway (LLM7, Kilo Gateway, or BlockRun) if Ollama cannot be reached. Off by default - this is the one setting that sends data off the machine.

key.name: barge-in-vad-enabled
key.summary: Interrupt spoken replies as soon as you start talking
key.description: When true, continuously monitors the microphone while Chronoa is speaking and interrupts immediately on detected speech, instead of only interrupting on the next button press or wake word. Off by default: there is no acoustic echo cancellation, so on speakers (not headphones) the mic may pick up Chronoa's own voice and self-interrupt.

key.name: llm7-api-key
key.description: Bring-your-own-key for the LLM7 free cloud gateway. Empty uses anonymous access (no key required); a real key may raise rate limits.

key.name: kilo-api-key
key.description: Bring-your-own-key for the Kilo Gateway free cloud gateway. Empty uses anonymous access; Kilo's own rate-limit errors suggest a real key raises the limit.

key.name: blockrun-api-key
key.description: Bring-your-own-key for the BlockRun free cloud gateway. Empty uses anonymous access, which shares a global free-tier quota with every other anonymous user.

key.name: openai-api-key
key.description: Required to use OpenAI as a cloud LLM fallback - OpenAI has no anonymous access. Empty means this provider is skipped.

key.name: anthropic-api-key
key.description: Required to use Anthropic (Claude) as a cloud LLM fallback - Anthropic has no anonymous access. Empty means this provider is skipped.

key.name: google-api-key
key.description: Required to use Google Gemini as a cloud LLM fallback - Google has no anonymous access. Empty means this provider is skipped.

key.name: groq-api-key
key.description: Required to use Groq as a cloud LLM fallback - Groq has no anonymous access. Empty means this provider is skipped.
